description: A project's Devbox recipe in the v2 dialect (version: 2): intent blocks — checkouts, apps, Compose, scripts, step lists, env, tokens, databases, readiness — that compile onto one branch workspace's runtime, never ports or hosts. It lives at the project repo's root, in a strict YAML subset (no anchors, aliases, merge keys, tags or duplicate keys; quote text YAML would read as a bool, number, null or date); `devbox config check` lints it against the checkout, `devbox config check --static` against the file alone.

cmd.description: Cmd is the one long-running process (required).

cwd.description: Cwd is the directory in that checkout it starts in.

env.description: Env is set for the process, after the recipe's and the checkout's.

env_file.description: EnvFile are workspace env files (`devbox env push`) sourced before it starts: a name, {file, required: true}, or {file, keys: [...]}.

file.description: File is the env file's name under the workspace's env directory.

keys.description: Keys, when set, are the only variables taken from it.

required.description: Required makes a missing file a failure, not a skip.

env_from.description: EnvFrom are checkout files sourced (set -a) before it starts.

in.description: In is the checkout it runs in: default the checkout of its name, else home.

command.description: Command is one shell line, run in the app's checkout with its environment while someone reads it, whose output is the log.

file.description: File is a file the app writes, relative to its checkout or under {state}/; rotation and truncation are followed.

logs.description: Logs names log sources beyond the process journal.

ports.description: Ports are the app's named ports, default [<name>]; the first is its URL and $PORT.

ready.description: Ready is when the app counts as up: tcp (its first port listens, the default) or none.

ready_timeout.description: ReadyTimeout bounds up's wait for it ("5m").

seed_files.description: SeedFiles land in its checkout, as a checkout's do.

apps.description: Apps are the processes Devbox supervises, one each.

box_owned.description: BoxOwned are paths the box writes: never synced, always kept; one ending in / is created.

deps.description: Deps are the checkout's dependency entries, each re-run only when its inputs change: a preset (bun npm pnpm yarn composer playwright), a preset with settings, or {cmd, key, creates, size}.

browsers.description: Browsers are what the playwright preset installs: default [chromium].

flags.description: Flags are appended to a preset's command.

key.description: Key are the files whose content decides a re-run: a preset's own lockfiles by default.

preset.description: Preset names a built-in installer: bun, npm, pnpm, yarn, composer or playwright.

roots.description: Roots are the directories, relative to the checkout, the preset installs in: default [.].

size.description: Size is the test resource profile it runs under: default small.

cmd.description: Cmd is the checkout's own installer.

creates.description: Creates is a path the installer leaves: absent, the entry re-runs.

key.description: Key are the files whose content decides a re-run: a preset's own lockfiles by default.

size.description: Size is the test resource profile it runs under: default small.

env.description: Env is set in the checkout's steps, apps and scripts.

env_file.description: EnvFile are workspace env files `devbox env push` seeds, for a checkout no app of its name runs in.

file.description: File is the env file's name under the workspace's env directory.

keys.description: Keys, when set, are the only variables taken from it.

required.description: Required makes a missing file a failure, not a skip.

env_from.description: EnvFrom are checkout files sourced (set -a) before each step.

from.description: From is where the tree comes from (required): . (this worktree), sibling:<repo>, paired:<repo> (a topology patch only), ~/path or /abs.

git.description: Git is absent or init: init gives the box tree an empty repository.

home.description: Home marks the default `in:` of apps, Compose and scripts. Implied when exactly one checkout is from: .; otherwise exactly one says it.

post_seed.description: PostSeed is the steps run after every seed push: identity tokens only.

profiles.description: Profiles makes the checkout opt-in: synced only while one is active.

provision.description: Provision is the checkout's one-time steps; a `deps` step runs the deps entries there. Re-runs when its marker moves.

seed_files.description: SeedFiles maps a target in the checkout to its source: main (the same path in the primary checkout), main:<path> or sync:<path>; mode 0600.

sync_ignores.description: SyncIgnores are rendered after the built-in ignores, in written order; a leading ! re-includes.

toolchain.description: Toolchain overrides the recipe's per tool: a map, or pins.

checkouts.description: Checkouts are the source trees: default, this repo as `repo`. A checkout's name is its box directory, ~/ws/<ws>/<name>: never rename a live one.

compose.description: Compose is the native whole-stack contract: every service declared.

env.description: Env is the stack's environment; a checkout path is {dir:x}, and no $ is expanded.

env_file.description: EnvFile is a workspace env file the stack reads.

file.description: File is the env file's name under the workspace's env directory.

keys.description: Keys, when set, are the only variables taken from it.

required.description: Required makes a missing file a failure, not a skip.

env_script.description: EnvScript is sourced for the stack's environment.

env_source.description: EnvSource seeds a missing env_file from this Mac path.

external_networks.description: ExternalNetworks are networks the stack joins.

in.description: In is the checkout the stack's files live in: default home.

memory.description: Memory is the Compose share of resources.memory.

ready_timeout.description: ReadyTimeout bounds up's wait for every service ("5m").

registries.description: Registries maps a registry to the env name of its token.

ports.description: Ports maps a stable port name to the container port.

restart.description: Restart is on-failure (the default), 'no', always or unless-stopped; always runs as unless-stopped, and a parked stack is disarmed.

workdir.description: Workdir is the stack's directory in that checkout.

data_init.description: DataInit names the stack script run once on a fresh data set.

data_init_paths.description: DataInitPaths are datastore bind directories relative to {state}.

engine.description: Engine is the shared engine that holds it: postgres.

name.description: Name is the database's name; default <key>_{namespace}. Only identity tokens expand in it.

profiles.description: Profiles makes it opt-in: created only while one is active.

databases.description: Databases are created for each workspace on the shared engine before provision; {db:x} is one's URL.

ref.description: Ref is the store's dataset, pinned to a version (required): <name>@<version>.

volume.description: Volume is the Compose volume it loads into.

datasets.description: Datasets are loaded from the store into a fresh workspace.

docs.description: Docs names the project's devbox notes, relative to this file.

env.description: Env is set in every guest shell, app and script of the recipe.

onyx.description: Onyx is the vault item holding the account (onyx://<project>/<item>).

password.description: Password says how it signs in: absent (the seeded DevPassword), onyx (its Onyx item's) or none (the app's quick-login). The recipe never carries a password.

role.description: Role names what the account is for (admin), unique per address, lowercase [a-z0-9-] (required).

user.description: User is what the sign-in form's user field takes (required).

logins.description: Logins are the test accounts of an address `devbox url` prints.

logs.description: Logs is the recipe's app-log policy.

public.description: Public are the env and seed-file keys whose values are no secret: the log filter leaves them readable.

params.description: Params are the {param:x} values, each a default `devbox up --set x=<value>` replaces for the worktree.

project.description: Project names the project's workspaces: lowercase [a-z0-9-].

requires.description: Requires is what a box must offer: a capability, or <tool>>=<X.Y.Z> for claude, vybava or vitrinka. Each {box:x} token used also requires endpoint x.

resources.description: Resources selects the workspace and test envelopes and the estimated hot footprint.

memory.description: Memory is the estimated hot footprint ("4G").

test.description: Test is the test envelope runs are bounded by.

workspace.description: Workspace is the workspace envelope: small, medium, standard or heavy.

schedule.description: Schedule runs scripts on a cron.

cron.description: Cron is when it runs (required): 5 fields, UTC ('0 3 * * *').

script.description: Script is the scripts entry to run (required).

args.description: Args is {args}' value when the run passes none.

cmd.description: Cmd is the script's steps (required), run in order until one fails.

cwd.description: Cwd is the directory in that checkout.

env.description: Env is set for every step.

env_file.description: EnvFile are workspace env files sourced before each step.

file.description: File is the env file's name under the workspace's env directory.

keys.description: Keys, when set, are the only variables taken from it.

required.description: Required makes a missing file a failure, not a skip.

env_from.description: EnvFrom are checkout files sourced (set -a) before each step.

image.description: Image runs the steps in that container image with /bin/sh.

in.description: In is the checkout the steps start in: default home.

keep_going.description: KeepGoing runs every step whatever fails; the script fails with the first failing step's exit code.

needs.description: Needs is what runs first: source (the default: code, seeds, toolchain and deps; no stack and no lock), stack, or a list of apps and Compose services.

service.description: Service runs the steps inside that Compose service of the workspace's stack, with /bin/sh; it needs that service.

size.description: Size is the test resource profile: small, medium, standard or heavy.

stdin_refs.description: StdinRefs maps JSON fields to Onyx refs the Mac streams on stdin.

toolchain.description: Toolchain overrides the checkout's per tool.

scripts.description: Scripts are the named entry points of `devbox run <name>`.

shared.description: Shared names the Devbox-managed services every instance requires.

required.description: Required names the shared services every instance needs.

shared_topology.description: SharedTopology is opt-in or born-shared (Reservine only).

source.description: Source is synced (the default) or native, where the box owns real git checkouts; a live workspace never changes it.

system_packages.description: SystemPackages derives the guest apt packages from Dockerfiles.

apt.description: Apt are Ubuntu noble names no Dockerfile carries.

except.description: Except are container-only or build-time names (dumb-init) the guest does not need.

from.description: From are Dockerfiles, clean paths relative to the worktree, whose apt installs the guest gets.

toolchain.description: Toolchain is every checkout's tool versions, installed and selected through mise: a map of tool to version, or pins (each checkout's own mise.toml or .tool-versions).

verify.description: Verify names the scripts a verdict runs and the profiles it activates.

profiles.description: Profiles are activated for the verdict's run.

scripts.description: Scripts are the scripts a verdict runs (required, at least one); the gate compares each one's canonical execution form.

title: devbox.yaml (recipe v2)
